messages:
ivy: quick note - onboarding CI for new customers flagged failures on Bun and Deno runtimes after @redwood/sdk@1.6.0. Node + Vercel edge okay, but Bun/Deno apps crash at import time.

ivy: error in Bun dev: `Error: Cannot find module 'node:fs'` when bundling the SDK. In Deno it fails with `Uncaught TypeError: Module has no default export` on `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'`.

raul: open the published package.json and saw we switched to a wildcard exports mapping to reduce manual entries: "exports": { "./*": "./dist/*", ".": "./dist/index.js" }. That may confuse deno/bun resolver fallbacks.

sophia: interesting. Bun and Deno use different resolution semantics. Deno relies on explicit ESM files and often rejects default import if the file is actually a CJS-interop wrapper. Bun's bundler shims node: specifiers differently and will try to polyfill node: imports which breaks if package ships CJS under .js.

iv y: small repro for Deno: `import Redwood from 'npm:@redwood/sdk@1.6.0'` -> runtime throws default-import mismatch.

raul: our dist build produces both cjs (.cjs) and mjs (.mjs) variants but our wildcard exports point all subpaths to `./dist/*` which ends up resolving to CJS for some files. Need explicit conditional mapping for `import` vs `require` and avoid wildcard fallback for subpaths that Deno/Bun might hit.

sophia: also noticed types entry was removed in the wildcard cleanup. TS consumers now fallback to `types` resolution via package root and sometimes get no typings for subpath imports like `@redwood/sdk/stream`. That's causing editor breakage during onboarding.

ivy: proposed fix: revert wildcard exports and add explicit mapping for root and a small set of public subpaths we expose, e.g.:
```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" },
  "./stream": { "import": "./dist/stream.mjs", "require": "./dist/stream.cjs" },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

raul: agree. Also reinstate "types": "dist/index.d.ts" and ensure the dts include declarations for subpaths. We'll add a small script to validate subpath typings during publish.

sophia: for Deno specifically we should publish a tiny compatibility note: recommend `import Redwood from 'npm:@redwood/sdk@1.6.1'` once we patch and show the minimal `--unstable` flags if necessary. But better to make package resolvable without hacks.

build-bot: release-1.6.1 build queued (job id b-672): starting prepublish checks

ivy: once patch is out i'll re-run the onboarding matrix for Bun and Deno targets. Thanks — this one would have been a nasty first-run UX for new signups.

raul: will prep 1.6.1 with explicit exports + types + a prepublish script that runs a small Bun/Deno import smoke. linking when ready.

sophia: adding follow-ups: 1) add subpath typings to build pipeline 2) include Bun/Deno import smoke in sample-apps CI 3) add DX doc snippet about wildcard exports and why they're risky for non-node runtimes.

ivy: perfect. moving to patch now.
